messages:
Anya: quick sync — uploaded S-XL-v2 weights to gs://rwd-weights/s-xl-v2/2026-03-12 but seeing tokenizer mapping weirdness when running chat templates. looks like sentinel and ZWJ interplay is trimming the leading BOS in some cases. can someone triage? @Sanjay?
Sanjay: on it. can you paste a minimal repro (prompt + tokenizer output)? also which serving config are you using (hosted/dedicated/private)?
Anya: hosted for now. repro below (small):
Anya: ```
chat_template = "User: {user}
‍assistant: {assistant}
<|endoftext|>"
prompt = chat_template.format(user="hi", assistant="")
# token-inspect output -> first tokens: [0x2, 0x200d, ...] (we expected BOS=0x1)
```
Ciara: hmm, looks like the template has an explicit ZWJ (‍) before the assistant sentinel. our tokenizer special_tokens.yaml maps '<|endoftext|>' to id 50256 but the model's tokenizer drops leading control bytes when ZWJ present.
Mike: are weights definitely the v2 build? earlier s-xl-v2 had a different merges file; path mismatch caused an older tokenizer.json to be loaded. gs path above is correct?
Anya: yes confirmed: gs://rwd-weights/s-xl-v2/manifest.json -> sha256 matches the upload. but our deploy logs show fallback to s-xl-v1/tokenizer.json for unknown reasons.
Jo: CI and config-validation flagged this yesterday: job `validate-model-config` failed with: 
Jo: ```
Traceback: TokenizerLoadError: tokenizer.json mismatch
  at load_tokenizer (model_loader.py:142)
  at validate_config (config_check.py:58)
```
Jo: stack points to our weights resolver which searches S3 first then GCS; if S3 has an older artifact with same name it wins.
deploy-bot: deploy-check: model-config-validate failed on pr/1009 — see https://ci.redwood.ai/1009
Sam: quick possible fix: pin `tokenizer_path` in model.yaml to the explicit GCS URL and add `force_tokenizer_sync: true` to the onboard script. also adding a tiny serving shim: if first token != BOS then inject BOS id at runtime — low-risk for rollout.
Sanjay: ^ agree with Sam. also add a test case to tokenizer-regressions with a ZWJ prefixed sentinel. i'll write the unit that token-inspect will run during CI.
Ciara: NOTE: when adding the unit test, assert both token ids and string->detokenized string equality because some merges produce identical ids but different decode behavior.
Anya: OK I'll open a PR with: pin tokenizer_path, add force sync, and a small runtime BOS fallback. PR will be draft until tests pass. tagging @Mike for weights integrity check.
Mike: will double-check S3 bucket for any stale artifacts and update routing so GCS has priority for new onboardings.
Anya: thanks — if someone can review the PR tonight that'd be awesome, otherwise will push a canary and monitor the console metrics (token drops). :thumbsup:
Sam: happy to review after tests land.
Sanjay: i'll add the ZWJ test and notify once green.
Anya: perfect — i'll paste PR link when ready and include a short repro script. thanks team!
